newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Broadcasting to seek Tokyo bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Broadcasting to seek Tokyo bourse listing.

text.p: Nippon Broadcasting System Inc, a Japanese radio broadcaster, said on Wednesday that it plans to list its shares on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE).
However, a company spokesman declined to disclose the timetable for the listing procedure.

Earlier in the day, mass circulation daily Yomiuri Shimbun reported that the broadcasting company's shares would be listed on the TSE as early as December upon receiving approval from the finance minister.
The company owns a 43.7 percent stake in Fuji Television Network Inc, one of Japan's five nationwide television networks.
